brief: The canvas displays a futuristic spaceship control panel, featuring several detailed switches and illuminated buttons arranged across a dashboard. The panel elements are static and rendered in sharp, geometric colors. The user interacts with the panel by clicking various buttons in a specific sequence. If the correct sequence is entered, the central windscreen section activates, depicting a vibrant, streaking effect of the spaceship entering hyperspace, accompanied by intense, dynamic visual motion that fills the screen.

prompt: build a spaceship control panel with buttons and switches and when the correct button is pressed the windscreen shows the spaceship going into hyperspace
statement: This sketch creates a futuristic spaceship control panel with interactive switches and buttons arranged in a dashboard layout. The interface features geometric design elements with distinct color coding for active and inactive states. Users must click the switches and buttons in a specific sequence to unlock the hyperspace activation feature. When the correct sequence is entered, the central windscreen section activates, displaying a dynamic hyperspace effect with thousands of particles streaking toward the center of the screen. The visualization uses a particle system with motion towards a focal point to simulate the sensation of entering hyperspace, while maintaining performance within strict frame budget constraints by limiting particle count and draw operations per frame.
